subject: Self-billing request + VAT identity snapshot for Q2 settlement
messages:
From: Alex Martin <amartin@velocicorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: VelociCorp Billing <billing@velocicorp.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Question on invoice VAT treatment and request for self-billing

Thanks Jasmine — quick one from our side. We received invoice 0426 from Redwood last week and our AP team flagged that the VAT handling between the UK and our Dublin entity doesn't match what we expected. Specifically:
- The invoice is net of VAT under a reverse-charge line, but our internal guidance wants a self-billed invoice from Redwood for platform fees where we (VelociCorp Ltd, IE) are treated as the supplier for VAT purposes.
- We can provide an EU VAT certificate but need to confirm the exact entity name and VAT ID you have on file.

Can you confirm: 1) which Redwood legal entity issued the invoice, 2) the VAT ID on the invoice, and 3) whether you can do a self-billing agreement so our AP can process payment without a hold? We're trying to avoid payment delay that would push the net collection into next quarter.

Thanks,
Alex
Finance Manager, VelociCorp
[VelociCorp internal reference: VC-INV-0426]
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <amartin@velocicorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, VelociCorp Billing <billing@velocicorp.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 10:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question on invoice VAT treatment and request for self-billing

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear note. 

Short answers up front: 
1) Issuing entity on invoice 0426: Redwood Inference Ltd (UK).
2) VAT ID on invoice: GB999888777.
3) We can enter a self-billing agreement, but there are two operational points we need to align on:
   - Which entity at VelociCorp will be recorded as the purchaser vs supplier (VelociCorp UK vs VelociCorp IE).
   - We need a copy of the VelociCorp VAT certificate for the entity that will be used for validation (preferably a PDF).

Ben — looping you in to coordinate the self-billing doc and the mechanics for reissuing a corrected invoice (if required) or adding a complementary self-billed invoice for Q2. Marissa — FYI on potential tax proof request; we may need tax ops to bless the reverse-charge vs self-bill approach.

Alex — can you attach the VAT cert and confirm the desired entity name (exact legal name) for the self-billing record? If we get that today, we can aim to produce the self-billed invoice + updated pack and unblock payment by Wednesday.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192]
From: Alex Martin <amartin@velocicorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: VelociCorp Billing <billing@velocicorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 08:37:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question on invoice VAT treatment and request for self-billing

Thanks Jasmine — attaching VelociCorp IE VAT cert and the AP processing checklist. The legal name we want on the self-bill is:

VelociCorp Holdings Ireland Ltd
VAT IE1234567A

AP note: if Redwood issues a self-billed invoice showing VelociCorp IE as the supplier (so we treat it as self-billed under Irish rules), we can release the payment immediately once the Doc is in our system.

Attachment: Veloci_VAT_Cert_2026.pdf

One twist: our tax team also flagged that because part of the services were provisioned to a UK-registered sub-entity in March (we had a mid-quarter entity migration), they may ask for a short reconciliation line showing which portion of the fees relate to UK consumption (subject to different post-Brexit rules). Not a blocker but something to flag.

Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <amartin@velocicorp.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, VelociCorp Billing <billing@velocicorp.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 15:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question on invoice VAT treatment and request for self-billing

Alex — appreciate the cert and the heads-up on the UK split. Two proposed paths (we can do either):

1) Self-billing path (faster): Redwood issues a self-billed invoice for the full platform fee with VelociCorp Holdings Ireland Ltd as supplier. We attach your VAT cert, include a note that the invoice is self-billed by mutual agreement, and produce a short reconciliation line item that attributes 12% of the fee to the UK sub-entity (placeholder number until you confirm exact split). Payment is released by you once DocuSign and cert are attached.

2) Reverse-charge + split credits (more conservative): We reissue the invoice showing two line items — one reverse-charged to VelociCorp IE (net) and one UK-sourced line with VAT applied by Redwood UK. That requires rework on our side and may take an extra 3–5 business days; payment hold will continue until reissue is accepted by your AP.

Operational ask: if you prefer option 1, can you sign the attached one-page self-billing agreement via DocuSign? I can prepare a reconciliation note and an appendix explaining the split methodology (we'll default to usage timestamps if you don't have an internal allocation).

Attachments: SelfBilling_Agreement_Redwood_v1.docx

Thanks — Ben
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
[ben@redwood.com]
From: Alex Martin <amartin@velocicorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: VelociCorp Billing <billing@velocicorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@velocicorp.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question on invoice VAT treatment and request for self-billing

Ben / Jasmine — option 1 (self-billing) looks best for our cashflow. I signed the DocuSign this afternoon and uploaded the VAT cert. Please proceed with the self-billed invoice and include a reconciliation appendix that shows the small UK-origin percentage (we'll reconcile the exact usage split internally and send you a finalized allocation by next week).

Critical for AP: please add the DocuSign envelope ID to the invoice metadata so our payables system can automatically pick it up (DocuSign: envelope-abcdef123456). Once we see the self-billed invoice with the attachments, we'll schedule payment for next-day processing.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn.

Alex Martin
Finance Manager, VelociCorp
[amartin@velocicorp.com | +44 20 7000 1234]

Attachment references: Veloci_Invoice_Q2_0426.pdf (original), Veloci_VAT_Cert_2026.pdf (uploaded), SelfBilling_Agreement_Redwood_v1.docx (signed)
